title: Projectile
text: Launched at 12 m/s, 50° above the horizontal. Compare the range with \(\dfrac{v^2 \sin 2\theta}{g}\).
plain: Launched at 12 m/s, 50° above the horizontal. Compare the range with v² sin 2θ / g.

title: Terminal velocity
text: Two identical balls fall 6 m. The blue one has drag and levels off at 3 m/s; the coral one has none.

title: Simple pendulum
text: A 1 kg bob on a 2.5 m rod, released from 25°. Kinetic and gravitational energy swap; gravitational energy is zero at the bottom.

title: Mass on a spring
text: A 1 kg mass released from the spring’s natural length. The period is \(2\pi\sqrt{\dfrac{m}{k}}\) and the total energy stays constant.
plain: A 1 kg mass released from the spring’s natural length. The period is 2π√(m/k) and the total energy stays constant.

title: Oscillator on a frictionless floor
text: A block pulled 0.5 m from a wall and released. Displacement and velocity are a quarter cycle apart.

title: Elastic collision
text: Carts of 1 kg and 2 kg collide elastically. Momentum and kinetic energy are both conserved.

title: Newton's cradle
text: Ball 1 swings in and Ball 5 swings out. Small losses slowly set them all swinging together.

title: Block on a ramp
text: A block slides down a 30° slope with \(\mu = 0.25\). Compare its acceleration with \(g(\sin\theta - \mu\cos\theta)\).
plain: A block slides down a 30° slope with μ = 0.25. Compare its acceleration with g(sin θ − μ cos θ).

title: Atwood machine
text: Masses of 2 kg and 3 kg over a fixed pulley. Compare \(a\) with \(\dfrac{(m_2 - m_1)g}{m_1 + m_2}\) and the pulley’s tension with \(\dfrac{2m_1 m_2 g}{m_1 + m_2}\).
plain: Masses of 2 kg and 3 kg over a fixed pulley. Compare a with (m₂ − m₁)g / (m₁ + m₂) and the pulley’s tension with 2m₁m₂g / (m₁ + m₂).

title: Cart pulled by a hanging mass
text: A 0.5 kg mass pulls a 1.5 kg cart along a frictionless bench. Compare \(a\) with \(\dfrac{m_2 g}{m_1 + m_2}\); once the mass lands, the cart coasts.
plain: A 0.5 kg mass pulls a 1.5 kg cart along a frictionless bench. Compare a with m₂g / (m₁ + m₂); once the mass lands, the cart coasts.

title: Motor car
text: A motor drives the back wheel up a slope. Try changing its speed and torque.

title: Dominoes
text: A rolling ball topples a row of dominoes. Follow the total energy as they fall.
